title: Local algebra and dimension comparison for a polynomial chart
statement: Let T be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme; def-weil-affine-spectrum], let f:X\to T be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism] and locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and let U be an affine open of X. Let e:U\to\mathbb A^n_T [def-nagata-relative-affine-space] be locally finitely presented and locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite], with projection composition equal to f restricted to U. For x in U put S equal to the stalk of f's fibre at the point represented by x [def-pc-scheme-fibre; def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. There exist a commutative ring R in the schemes' universe, a regular local ring structure on R [def-weil-regular-scheme], a local ring homomorphism \varphi:R\to S, and natural numbers d,r,t, such that S is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], \dim R=d, \dim S=r, \dim(S/\mathfrak m_R S)=0 [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], r\le d, the topological dimension at x of f's fibre is r+t [def-kun-topological-dimension-at-point], n=d+t, and e's stalk map at x is flat if and only if \varphi is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Tags 00RE (dimension comparisons in the proof), 00R7, and 00RH (polynomial stalk and fibre stalk comparison), with the field dimension formula Tag 00P1; read 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Take the explicitly constructed polynomial fibre stalk R and canonical local map φ into the actual fibre stalk S. R is regular local and φ is quasi-finite. Finite presentation of f makes its residue-field fibre locally Noetherian, hence S is Noetherian. No arbitrary witness is chosen.

The proved canonical fibre dimension theorem gives d,r,t, both local ring dimensions, the fibre topological dimension r+t and n=d+t. For a quasi-finite map the prime contraction map is strictly monotone, so dim S≤dim R. A prime of S above the ideal m_R S contracts to m_R; quasi-finite incomparability makes every prime of the closed fibre maximal. The quotient is a nontrivial local ring because φ is local; hence its dimension is exactly zero. The natural-number dimension equality turns dim S≤dim R into r≤d.
Apply the chart stalk/closed-fibre flatness comparison to this same canonical map φ, and assemble all conjuncts without changing the original theorem statement.

proof_origin.place: Tags 00RE, 00P1 and 00RH: canonical categorical fibre construction and proved dimension comparison, with only the local flatness comparison separated for a subsequent worker. K2 reduction 2026-10-13.

lean.statement:
theorem polynomial_chart_local_algebra
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine T] (f : X ⟶ T)
    [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (U : X.Opens) [IsAffine U.toScheme] (n : ℕ)
    (e : U.toScheme ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation e] [LocallyQuasiFinite e]
    (he : e ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) T ↘ T) = U.ι ≫ f)
    (x : U.toScheme) :
    let S := (f.fiber (f (U.ι x))).presheaf.stalk (f.asFiber (U.ι x))
    ∃ (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsRegularLocalRing R)
      (φ : R →+* S) (_ : IsLocalHom φ) (d r t : ℕ),
      IsNoetherianRing S ∧
      ringKrullDim R = (d : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      ringKrullDim S = (r : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      ringKrullDim (S ⧸ (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map φ) = 0 ∧
      r ≤ d ∧
      topologicalKrullDimAt (f.asFiber (U.ι x)) = ((r + t : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞) ∧
      n = d + t ∧
      ((e.stalkMap x).hom.Flat ↔ φ.Flat)
